name: Binary to Text
summary: Decode 8-bit binary byte strings into readable UTF-8 text.
description: Paste binary digits grouped as bytes (space-separated) and convert them back to plain text. A focused decoder companion to the full Binary Encode / Decode tool.

faqs.question: What format should I paste?
faqs.answer: Eight-bit groups like 01001000 01100101 — spaces between bytes are optional.

faqs.question: UTF-8 support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bytes are decoded as UTF-8 text.
